evals.prompt: Ingest https://martinfowler.com/bliki/TwoHardThings.html into my SWE wiki at {wiki_root}. I already approve `backend/caching` as the primary domain, so go ahead without asking me again.
evals.expected_output: Full ingest: raw immutable copy of the URL page, filled source page with summary, related pages updated, indexes rebuilt, ingest log entry, lint clean.
expectations: Raw layer holds an immutable local copy of the URL page under raw/backend/caching/
Source page exists and has no `_Fill during ingestion._` placeholders
Source page has a non-empty `summary` frontmatter field
An existing durable page in backend/caching links to the new source page
Source page cites at least one related external URL besides the source
wiki/log.md has an `ingest` entry
Strict (new) mechanical lint reports no errors
evals.name: ingest-url-preapproved

evals.prompt: add these notes to my swe wiki please: {files}/inputs/cache-stampede-notes.md (wiki lives at {wiki_root})
evals.expected_output: Stops before writing: proposes one primary domain with reasons and alternatives, gives key takeaways, related pages and contradictions, asks what to emphasize. Wiki unchanged.
expectations: Wiki and raw trees are unchanged before approval
Response recommends a primary domain in kebab-case path form
Response gives key takeaways from the notes
Response names related existing wiki pages (cache invalidation)
Response asks the user what to emphasize
Response explicitly waits for approval before writing
evals.name: ingest-local-needs-approval

evals.prompt: Run a health check on my SWE wiki at {wiki_root}. Fix what you safely can and list anything that needs my input.
evals.expected_output: Mechanical lint passes or failures are reported; placeholder page fixed or flagged; TTL contradiction (60s vs 300s) named; gaps with suggested questions/sources recorded; lint log entry with follow-ups.
expectations: wiki/log.md has a `lint` entry
The lint log entry records Follow-ups
cdn-caching placeholder is fixed in the page or flagged to the user
Response names the TTL contradiction (60 s vs 300 s)
Response suggests new questions or sources to fill gaps
Strict (new) mechanical lint reports no errors after repair
evals.name: lint-repair-with-gaps

evals.prompt: Using my SWE wiki at {wiki_root}: should our product catalog use write-through caching or event-driven purge? Cite the wiki pages, and save the comparison into the wiki so we keep it.
evals.expected_output: Answer cites wiki pages; a question page is filed under backend/caching following AGENTS.md local conventions (team-platform tag, Decision Checklist section); indexes and query log updated.
expectations: A `kind: question` page is filed in the wiki
Question page carries the local-convention tag `team-platform`
Question page ends with a `## Decision Checklist` of 3-5 checkbox items
Response cites both cache-invalidation and write-through-cache pages
Question page is listed in its local index
wiki/log.md has a `query` entry
evals.name: query-files-answer-with-local-convention

notes: Copy the fixture wiki in files[0] to a fresh directory and substitute it for {wiki_root}; {files} is evals/files. Grade with: python3 evals/grade.py <iteration-dir>.
